notes.title: Dying Light and Hunt Showdown rival Sker Ritual gets reimagined in new update
notes.content:
If you want to have a spooky good time with friends you have no shortage of potential options. Arcade action like the Killing Floor or goofy hijinks in Lethal Company can entertain for hours. Even in this crowded field, Sker Ritual  stands out. It's a co-op horror shooter with some serious heft, calling to mind games like Dying Light and Hunt: Showdown. The latest update for Sker Ritual is a major one, adding oft-requested features and brand new layers of customization.
Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE - Voice Chat, Third-Person & Custom Games
notes.content:
SKER ISLANDERS! 



Oh do we have the mother of all updates for YOU. As promised in our 2025 roadmap, this update has third person mode and a custom game mode. We've also introduced a trial for the most requested feature...


Sker Ritual Patch v.1.3 - 10/07/2025 

VOICE CHAT TRIAL ADDED
Surprise players! After hearing your feedback our team have been experimenting with communication options to better your Sker experience. This is our first time implementing a voice chat feature and so we're trialling it for players on PC. We would love it if you could try it out and feed back to our team in the comments below, on Discord or across our socials. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/4d23594d93d4e47a852ab7b7f79969c0f115a08a.gif"]

  
THIRD PERSON MODE ADDED
Sker Ritual is now playable in third person mode! Select in the graphics options your preferred type of view: first person or third person. You then have the option to select from three third person mode types: 


NEAR
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/ad0016d2c47a2e583d4ad79bba3ffc72597bca5e.gif"]


NORMAL 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/17bb535d17479363f67790f623cc7b0679b87366.gif"]

 
FAR
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/b6c90458dc301eee964842332933ec131a59e2ee.gif"]


CUSTOM GAME MODE ADDED
Bring full chaos to your games with over 70 modifiers to choose from in our new custom game mode. These solo or private games can be selected in the difficulty menu. But be warned, some modifiers will disable your chance to earn XP. Earning achievements and masks will also be disabled in this mode.  

    
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/a0a41248adf2094bf3c64eafb9337c1cfbb64155.gif"]


Want to stomp on your enemies by making them teeny tiny? Well, now you can! Want to get stomped on by your enemies by making them giant? Well, now you can do that too! Plus, add a touch of anti-gravity to make dealing with those Quiet Ones extra satisfying. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/ac216c823c95131462f2f24b6ac1a11684eff943.gif"] 

We look forward to seeing all of your custom game chaos. Share your favourite modifiers and moments with us on socials! As always, we welcome feedback and if you have additional ideas for custom game modifiers our team definitely want to hear them. 



Wales Interactive

notes.content:
Sker Islanders, the wait is over. Sker Ritual: Deadly Lover's Fortress is OUT NOW! We hope you're ready to  take on the challenges of this fourth and final episode on our Early Access journey.

What can you expect from Deadly Lover's Fortress? Hidden in the dark depths of a decaying fortress lies the root of all evil. Stop Elisabeth's plans from coming to fruition and prepare to face your ultimate nemesis. Rain down on Elisabeth and save humanity! 

[previewyoutube=2CSit6hDYuA;full][/previewyoutube]
FACE AN EPIC THREE BOSS FINALE

In Deadly Lover's Fortress, players will undertake three pivotal missions that pave the way for their confrontation with a three-boss finale featuring Isaac, Abraham and The Stranger, whilst fighting off hordes of Quiet Ones and challenging new Elite Enemies like the hard-hitting hammer knight Balor. Welcome back Sker Islanders to The Ashes of Sker Hotel, we hope you, and your squad, enjoy your stay.

What challenges and terrors await you in a dilapidated Sker Hotel? Players will re-explore the Main Floor and the Basement and discover the secret path to other familiar and new locations around the hotel. KILLERWATTS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/865e4427e828f8f93cec7e152f9738297997ad53.png

HUSKS
Don't be fooled by Husk's ordinary Quiet One appearance, you'll need to be careful where you shoot or you (and your teammates) will be faced with an even more dangerous threat. Friendly collateral activated.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/cad3058270543de5762a43a5fc94834c23044c66.png

SHOOTING SOUND

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/24c9510b6faa2bbd98d8e3b0f360360ae572406d.gif

LEVEL MODIFIER

notes.title: Developer Update #4 - Post Demo Feedback
notes.content:
First and foremost, we want to say a big thank you to everyone who played the Demo in the Steam Next Fest and especially those who left us feedback and suggestions! We are extremely excited to bring you Sker Ritual, and we love the support we are getting from you all! Whether you wishlist Sker Ritual, followed the game or joined our discord we love you! 

We are a small team from Wales and we are listening to this community and updating and improving to make this game as great as it could be! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/ffb5ee4727083da844d2d701f1640e8f1c9e461e.gif

Animations 

The animations in general are now a lot smoother and in particular, the enemies also have more reactive reactions. 

Audio 

We are balancing a lot of the audio elements and improving multiple areas, including the protection of your eardrums with the generators in the village. We have improved the enemies' sounds and reaction audio and we are busy adding more background audio, ambience audio and menu music too. 

Weapons 

A lot of community feedback focused on the weapons, in particular, especially the aiming flick/spin and sometimes unintentional stargazing, the Quiet Ones didn’t share the same enthusiasm for a new hobby so we did fix it. The weapons are now feeling a little more balanced in reloading and firing speeds and the weapons also are now not operated by using your head but are more appropriately located in your arms.  

Enemies 

We are fixing our favourite bug “The Bouncing Banshee”, it took a while to catch her but once we did, we agreed constantly teleporting from her problems wasn’t the best option. Enemies on spawning and causing a lag have now also been fixed, everyone now forms an orderly queue. 

Ghost Mode 

We have improved “Ghost Mode” a little too, the undead are now a little less clairvoyant and will not block your way.   

Miracles 

You can expect a miracle! We will be explaining Miracles very soon and are improving the in-game usability of them and understanding of what each one does.

notes.title: Sker Ritual FAQ
notes.content:
WELCOME TO THE OFFICIAL SKER RITUAL FAQ! 

If you have any questions you’d like to see added, we’d love to hear it! Please leave a comment here (or reach us on Twitter, Reddit) for the developers to curate and answer. 

We will be updating the FAQ as we continue to develop the game, answering more questions while also updating ones we’ve answered previously. You will find more detailed information about the game in our weekly Developer Updates! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/a08102c818b17199dd2a65325824f2b1b8494381.gif

What is Sker Ritual? 

Sker Ritual is the spiritual successor to our award-winning, single-player horror game, Maid of Sker. Inspired by the Maid of Sker Challenge mode, we wanted to allow our players to play with friends online, and explore what we could achieve in an online co-op multiplayer. 

What type of gameplay can we expect? 

Sker Ritual is a co-op wave shooter first and foremost but it will feature in-game challenges, tasks, and some soon-to-be-revealed events, which will reward you with story content (as well as unlockable content). The choice is yours, play solo if you're brave enough or grab up to 4 players to tackle the onslaught of Quiet men together. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/19dcebef2773a4a5d9fb599533ea82d7d9e38a98.gif

What time period is this game going to be set in? 

Set shortly after the events of Maid of Sker, Sker Ritual takes place in the early-1900s with a little more of a steampunk influence. There is action, adventure, survival horror, mystery, and a little gothic science fiction. Sker Hotel has moved on a little since you last saw it, it's now in the 20th Century and has a few surprises still to come. 

Why Wales? 

As a team of Welsh developers (some are adopted), we believe there is a rich talent pool, history, and mythology available in Wales that deserves to be discovered. For those across the pond who may not know, although we are joined with England by land, and we are part of Great Britain, Wales is a country in its own right. Not to be confused with the Australian state New South Wales, Wales is the one with the dragon on the flag! 

Will there be a beta? 

Yes! We hope to bring you a beta phase opportunity soon. Our development team are working tirelessly to bring you the smoothest multiplayer experience. We strongly recommend subscribing to our newsletters, forums and socials to ensure you don't miss out on an exclusive beta opportunity. See below for all our sign-up links. 

What weapons are going to be in Sker Ritual?  

Those following our Developer Updates get a sneak peek into The Laughing Policeman's Magnificent Munitions shop where base weapons can be bought at high-risk locations. The real fun comes with the unique weapon upgrades at The Laughing Policeman's Super Charger (remember we mentioned our Steampunk influence?). We’ve barely scratched the surface here, we have so much more to reveal soon! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/be339f1995c1508d0418a12847c625438d392166.gif

What maps are included?	 

We're bringing you “The Cursed Lands of Lavernock”, get to know it better in our series of updates where we highlighted the abandoned Cathedral, the underground living quarters, the ancient farmland and — a mysterious looking chamber? Hey everyone, 

It’s time for a sneak preview and we want to share with you “The Cursed Lands of Lavernock”. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/aac07f45fbad1b8034370bd728315d648dff5e93.jpg

In "The Cursed Lands of Lavernock", players will be exploring a new area of Sker Island taking on waves of the "Quiet Ones". From a small fishing village to a secret underground Laboratory, players will have to use their wits to survive the onslaught and complete their mission across an abandoned Cathedral and areas reminiscent of Sker Hotel. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/876063abca41f4b9c4532a603bb15c021339332c.jpg
The long since Abandoned Cathedral now lays host to ritualistic effigies, with plenty of hidden passages for the Quiet Ones to hunt from 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/8e57247076e7f064d51997a5e0e95a105da8621e.jpg
The Underground Living Quarters holds many secrets, twisting and turning, with areas easily overwhelmed if you’re not careful 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/b3d8bb80cc664e07223e4c7c53ccedddf8075a4c.jpg
The Ancient Farmland is the perfect place for a respite, or an ambush, watch out for the remains of the Quiet Ones previous victims, you can’t save them now 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/687576a7afdbf6ce62240e05d8b27bea6f61d226.jpg
The Mysterious Chamber holds the unknown behind its doors, only the brave can discover 

In Sker Ritual, players will come up against the turned residents of Sker Island. These new "Quiet Ones" pose no real threat to the players but make sure to keep their numbers low or otherwise they will overwhelm you and cause a lot of trouble. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/d58aeb82887af27bea705c5b8210f9281e9d44de.gif

Disorientating with her sonic screams The Banshee has the ability to seemingly appear out of thin air, right behind you. 

Lost to the depths The Mariner, somehow now returned and vengeful, his helmet is his power with laser precision you need to stay out of his line of “sight”  

Evening the playing field, he can’t see you and you can’t see him, The Phantom aim carefully or you might just miss him but he will find you.

notes.title: Developer Update #1 - All about Sker
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Welcome back to the world of Sker!

Thank you for joining us in our series of developer updates, explaining more about Sker Ritual and answering even more of your questions. We are a team of 12 Welsh developers, the same team that maid– sorry, made –Maid of Sker. Despite our small size we’re always scouting the forums (and Twitter) and do read all of your questions and comments, so we’d like to try and answer these right now and in the following developer updates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/028d8d54f2e29f0838b7a63636fafd12bc9ab447.jpg

To co-op or not
With Sker Ritual we aim to bring you and your friends together in an online co-op shooter that leads on from the story of Maid of Sker. You can still tackle the onslaught and discover the story alone, just in case you’re not feeling very social [we get that] but it’s most enjoyed playing with up to a 4-strong team, whether they be friends or future-friends from online matchmaking.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/ff3c6bbb8c411937b4fdd8d781bee087b5923fc0.gif

Continuing the Sker
Sker Ritual does have some familiar faces and a story that leads on from Maid of Sker (more about that soon!) but it is not Maid of Sker 2. Sker Ritual has so many new and familiar faces. We love the characters we created in Maid of Sker and wanted to see how far we could push character creation from a multiplayer perspective within what is already a sker-y world.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41492909/be966f06b88ab77c23c9ba7a6e7ffa3832a87f70.jpg

When does Sker Ritual take place?
The game is based after the events of Maid of Sker, in the 1900s but with a little more of a steampunk influence that was touched on in the single-player horror. Make no mistake this is a wave shooter with a well-written story campaign built-in. Expect close-up action, dark adventure, zombie-esque survival, lots of customization, and some gothic science fiction for good measure. Sker Hotel has moved on a little since you last saw it, it's now in the 20th Century and has a few surprises still to come.

We are working hard to bring you an exciting, high-quality, multiplayer experience and we can’t wait to connect with new and existing fans. Stay tuned for dev update 'dau' (two) coming soon.
